tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Comprehensive Operation & Maintenance (O&M) for Five (5) Years of a 225 kWp Grid-Connected Distributed Solar Photovoltaic (DSPV) Power Plant on the Rooftops of Buildings within the Premises of Karnataka State Agricultural Produce Processing & Export Corporation Limited (KAPPEC) at APMC Yard, Amargol, Hubballi, including Roof-Edge Safety Railings, Roof Walkways/Pathways, Pressure Pump with Necessary Piping and Associated Works

itemList.description:
Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning (SITC) of 225 kWp Grid Connected Distributed Solar Photovoltaic (DSPV) System on turnkey basis, comprising supply of ALMM-listed, DCR-compliant mono-crystalline Solar PV Modules conforming to BIS/MNRE standards and HESCOM requirements; Grid Interactive String Inverter(s) of suitable capacity for the 225 kWp DSPV plant, suitable for 230V/440V, 3-Phase, 50Hz operation and conforming to the latest MNRE/CEA/BIS standards; suitable module mounting structures; AC and DC power cables; wiring accessories; manual disconnect switches; AC Distribution Board (ACDB); DC Distribution Board (DCDB); suitable number of chemical earthing systems with copper-bonded rods of minimum 2 metre length, as required for the capacity of the system; lightning protection system; Surge Protection Devices (SPD); fuses; connectors; conduits; cable trays; clamps; junction boxes; hardware; civil works required for mounting structures; and all other miscellaneous materials required for successful installation of the Solar Power Plant, including transportation, loading, unloading, erection, testing, commissioning, grid synchronization, documentation and handing over, complete for 225 kWp capacity. Supply of suitable Electronic Three Phase Solar Energy Meter, complete with tamper-proof, weatherproof Meter Protection Box/Enclosure, conforming to the latest CEA Regulations and BIS Standards and compatible with HESCOM/KERC requirements, including all necessary mounting accessories, complete for the 225 kWp Grid Connected Rooftop Solar PV System. Supply of suitable Electronic Three Phase, Four Wire LT Bi-directional Net Energy Meter with CTs/PTs of suitable ratio, from manufacturers approved/empanelled by HESCOM, complete with tamper-proof, weatherproof Meter Protection Box/Enclosure, conforming to the latest CEA Regulations and BIS/HESCOM Standards, including all necessary mounting accessories, complete for the 225 kWp Grid Connected Rooftop Solar PV System.
Modification/Upgradation of the existing HT metering cubicle associated with the solar PV plant by supplying, installing, testing and commissioning CTs and PTs of suitable ratings and ratios as approved by HESCOM, along with any required metering equipment, test terminal block, busbar modifications, wiring, modem/communication arrangements and accessories. The upgraded metering arrangement shall be suitable for 3-phase, 4-wire metering and comply with the latest applicable CEA/BIS standards and HESCOM requirements for solar PV plant interconnection and energy accounting, complete in all respects. Supply and Installation of Roof-Edge Safety Railings, Staircases and Walkways, complete with all necessary supports, fixtures and accessories. Supply and Installation of Pressure Pump with necessary piping and all associated works, complete in all respects.

O&M Charges for Five Years-Comprehensive Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of the 225 kWp Grid Connected Distributed Solar Photovoltaic (DSPV) System for a period of Five (5) Years, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, cleaning of PV modules, replacement of defective components covered under warranty/O&M, performance monitoring, submission of maintenance reports, and all labour, tools, consumables and incidental services required for satisfactory operation of the plant, complete in all respects, excluding GST.
